about: A library of one page of our own, for the release workflow: it builds this library with lastbook-tools, opens it in each packaged app and takes a picture of the PDF page, which shows that the app found the PDFium installed beside it.

pack.title: Release check
pack.summary: One PDF page, to see that the packaged app draws PDF pages.

documents.title: A PDF page, drawn by PDFium

documents.notes: Made for the release check; it belongs to no library people install.
